title: Scout replay sweep v1
description: A named, versioned, one-axis batch-replay sweep: either every variant shares one candidate model and varies only its system prompt (axis: prompt), or every variant shares one candidate system prompt and varies only its model (axis: model). At least two named variants are required, and a variant may only carry the field matching the declared axis, plus an optional `reasoning` switch (true/false pins the model's reasoning mode on every request; omitted defers to the sweep's shared `reasoning`, and omitting both leaves the provider default).

model.description: Shared candidate model for every variant of a prompt-axis sweep. Omit to reuse each baseline case's own recorded model.

prompt_file.description: Shared candidate system-prompt file (UTF-8, resolved relative to the sweep document's own directory) for every variant of a model-axis sweep. Omit to reuse each baseline case's own recorded system prompt.

reasoning.description: Shared reasoning (thinking) switch for every variant that does not set its own. Omit to leave the provider default.
